reason: A more plausibly links local chemical/lattice strain to dislocation resistance and phonon-mediated thermoelastic behavior, whereas B incorrectly attributes near-constant elastic moduli to a screw-to-edge slip transition and proposes methods poorly suited to measuring dislocation character in situ. A still needs a better compositionally controlled baseline and should distinguish configurational entropy from atomic-size/chemical misfit, but it is the stronger testable proposal.
